displayIdentity.body: A prayer asks for return, love, and established hearts. Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you. to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
